name: All Nighter
source:
It's Friday afternoon, but instead of enjoying the weekend, a highschool student (you) must endure a detention session with six other troublemaker students. Things take a turn for the worse when an unexpected storm cuts the power and your teacher goes missing. Unexplained events and scenarios will find the characters in a bind and put you into a spooky situation. It's up to you to figure out who's responsible.

[From [url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/38966703/]FurAffinity[/url]]
translation:
现在是星期五下午，但一名高中生（你）并没有享受周末，而是必须忍受与其他六名麻烦学生的留校。当一场意外的暴风雨切断电源并且你的老师失踪时，事情变得更糟。无法解释的事件和场景会让角色陷入困境，让你陷入诡异的境地。由你来决定谁该负责。

[来自[url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/38966703/]FurAffinity[/url]]
